caption: The drawing features two rectangular panels side by side on a tan, aged-looking background. The left panel contains a detailed, monochromatic design drawn in a dark red color. This panel is filled with an intricate pattern of large and small flowers, leafy stems, and two birds perched among the foliage—one bird at the top facing right and another bird at the bottom facing left. The floral elements are dense and overlap, creating a layered appearance. The right panel shows a more spaced-out arrangement of smaller botanical elements, also in red, but with less densely packed details. It has individual sprigs with leaves and flowers, scattered at various angles. Some smaller blossoms and buds are distributed between the larger floral clusters. The composition is symmetrical with the two panels aligned vertically. At the bottom of the drawing, texts include scale information, location name (“WESTCHESTER COUNTY”), and the name “EDMOND W. BROWN.”
title: Patchwork Quilt
